text:
Elena Park: Quick sync: planning a small private DP run to validate onboarding friction, perf, and go/no-go signals. Target cohort=6, staggered starts, 21-45 day pilots depending on integration.

Ravi Kapoor: Agree. Suggest mix: 2 regulated (health/fin), 2 mid-market SaaS, 1 reseller/platform, 1 startup edge case.

Jules Martin: Add one embeddings-first use case (search relevance) so we capture embed throughput SLOs separately.

Elena Park: Good — we'll publish two SLO buckets: generation and embeddings. Gen baseline p50 < 75ms, p95 < 280ms @ 256 tokens. Embed baseline p50 < 25ms, p95 < 70ms.

Anya Lopez: Recruitment screener (short): 1) primary use & compliance needs 2) steady QPS + peak 3) start window 4) willing to share small eval set? Keep it 4 lines.

Ravi Kapoor: Outreach copy must call out: VPC vs on-prem, KMS/HSM support, data residency, logs/access we need, incentives.

Elena Park: Incentives proposal: 2 months discounted Dedicated credits + up to 5 days dev support + co-marketing option for strategic partners.

Jules Martin: Success gates per partner: A) E2E integration validated B) Perf SLOs met in production-like run C) Security checklist cleared D) Feedback engagement >= 6 labeled cases + repros.

Anya Lopez: Define "labeled case": sample prompt + expected behavior + severity tag + triage ticket. Partners must submit 6 families of 8-10 examples each.

Ravi Kapoor: Ops metrics to capture: days-to-first-successful-call (target <=7), eng FTE-days (target <=5), time-to-triage (target <=48h).

Elena Park: We'll include a rollback/fallback clause in the DP agreement (legal please review). Also maintenance windows will be documented upfront.

legal-bot: Note: include anonymized metrics consent and safe-harbor for experimental pilots. NDA + DP addendum template in #legal-dp.

Jules Martin: Tooling we'll provide: replay harness repo, token-level sensor script, eval CSV template. Partners asked to run smoke tests before production flip.

Anya Lopez: Feedback cadence: weekly async notes, mid-pilot 60-90m review, final deep-dive. Post-pilot monthly check-ins for 3 months.

Ravi Kapoor: For large enterprise, accept 45-day pilots but log scope trades: extra eng time vs longer window. Track in a trade-log sheet.

Elena Park: Action items: @Anya finalize screener + outreach by EOD Thu. @Jules publish eval template and smoke scripts. @Ravi prepare agent + replay harness docs. @Legal review DP addendum. I'll curate shortlist and send invites Fri.

eng-bot: COHORT CREATED dp-priv-nov-2025. Calendar kickoff placeholder 2025-11-12 09:00 PT.

Anya Lopez: Outreach draft will be in #product/outreach by 1400 PT tomorrow.

Elena Park: Thanks all — RSVP to the invite-review huddle if you want to join Friday 08:30 PT.

legal-bot: Reminder: legal sign-off required before invites are sent.
